dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale-white boundaries along the distal edges of the folded flight feathers against a dark grayish-brown base.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct linear transition boundary separating the uniform grayish-brown crown and nape from the high-contrast scaled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Repetitive, high-contrast concentric scalloping across the wing coverts and scapulars defined by bright white feather fringes.
